title: Hybrid Sequential Feedback Optimization for Wind Farm Power Maximization
summary: This paper considers feedback optimization for optimal steady-state operation of nonlinear discrete-time systems when the steady-state input-output map and its sensitivity are expensive to compute. We propose a hybrid extension of sequential feedback optimization (SFO) that augments the model-based SFO gradient with correction terms through a convex combination with summable diminishing weights.
